format: per take, per tick: part rot (xRot,yRot,zRot rad, model space before the body yaw/roll), offset_px, pos [right, forward, up] blocks, body_heading/body_climb and arm_heading/arm_climb (deg; heading clockwise), roll_deg (+ = right side down). 20 ticks a second.
rule: ring arm: xRot = -(90 deg + arm_climb), yRot = arm_heading - body_heading; the arm follows the player's movement input/velocity now, the body follows the same direction 1.6 ticks (0.08 s) later
